```sql
select id, status, method from payments as p where not exists (select 1 from orders as o where o.id = p.order_id and o.discount > 0.3 and (o.amount < p.amount or o.order_date <= '2025-01-27'))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

    df_payments.alias("p")
    .join(
        df_orders.filter(F.col("discount") > 0.3).alias("o"),
        (F.col("o.id") == F.col("p.order_id"))
        & ((F.col("o.amount") < F.col("p.amount")) | (F.col("o.order_date") <= "2025-01-27")),
        "left_anti",
    )
    .select(F.col("p.id"), F.col("p.status"), F.col("p.method"))
)
```

```sql
SELECT a.id, a.customer_id, a.status, a.opened_date AS account_opened_date FROM accounts a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customers c WHERE a.customer_id = c.id AND (c.signup_date >= a.opened_date OR c.email = 'alice@gmail.com')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s WHERE s.customer_id = a.customer_id AND monthly_fee >= 83 AND (start_date < '2024-11-12' OR end_date > '2023-11-10'))
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

result = (
    df_accounts.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_customers.alias("c"),
        (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"))
        & ((F.col("c.signup_date") >= F.col("a.opened_date")) | (F.col("c.email") == "alice@gmail.com")),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .join(
        df_subscriptions.filter(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 83).filter((F.col("start_date") < "2024-11-12") | (F.col("end_date") > "2023-11-10")).alias("s"),
        F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("a.customer_id"),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .select(
        F.col("a.id"),
        F.col("a.customer_id"),
        F.col("a.status"),
        F.col("a.opened_date").alias("account_opened_date"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH subscriptions_with_customers AS (SELECT s.id, s.plan, s.status, s.monthly_fee FROM subscriptions s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM customers c WHERE c.id = s.customer_id AND c.email <> 'alice@gmail.com' AND (name IS NOT NULL OR NOT is_active) AND c.signup_date > s.end_date)) SELECT plan, status, SUM(monthly_fee) AS total_monthly_fee FROM subscriptions_with_customers GROUP BY plan, status;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

subscriptions_with_customers = (
    df_subscriptions.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_customers.filter(F.col("email") != "alice@gmail.com").filter((F.col("name").isNotNull()) | (~F.col("is_active"))).alias("c"),
        (F.col("c.id") == F.col("s.customer_id")) & (F.col("c.signup_date") > F.col("s.end_date")),
        "left_semi",
    )
    .select(F.col("s.id"), F.col("s.plan"), F.col("s.status"), F.col("s.monthly_fee"))
)

result = (
    subscriptions_with_customers
    .groupBy("plan", "status")
    .agg(F.sum(F.col("monthly_fee")).alias("total_monthly_fee"))
)
```

```python
    df_stores.alias("s")
```
